summary: The desktop unit test runner uses vitest's thread pool instead of one forked process per test file. Developer and CI tooling only; no app behaviour changes.

desktop.reason: Test runner configuration only; no src change.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app's tests run under jest, which is unchanged.

automated: npx vitest run --pool=threads --maxWorkers=50%: 630 files, 6674 tests passed in 73 s; launchservicesd sampled every 3 s, median 0.2%.
CI on this pull request runs the suite under threads on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
notExercised: A fork-pool baseline on the same commit (observed earlier the same day at 100-190% launchservicesd across three runs, not re-measured).
